title: Feature clips: a repeatable kit, then the balanced-edges copy clip
summary: A shared Windows/macOS kit (pinned VS Code) for looping 5-12 s feature clips: MP4, WebM, light GIF in Git LFS under docs/demo-video/clips/; a release step (MP4 as post 1 hook, owner uploads it into the GitHub release); the site plays the WebM (feat); first clip: raw copy with balanceEdges on.
